thread:
maria: FYI — escalation from Acme. Customer reports intermittent 500/502 on /v1/generate and some generated text appears to contain what looks like PII. They supplied request id r-110f8c2a. Can someone pick this up? Need repro steps, sanitized prompt, curl, and a debug bundle.

alex: grabbing logs now. maria, can you confirm timestamp + model details? also ask them to include which environment (hosted vs dedicated).

maria: timestamp 2026-03-16T18:22:11Z, model redwood/lite-v2, max_tokens 512. App team said the prompt included customer invoice content. I'm asking them to mask names/emails/SSNs before they paste anything here.

jordan: @maria when you ask them, can you send this minimal curl for a repro and request headers with --include. example:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/lite-v2","input":"<SANITIZED_PROMPT>","max_tokens":512,"temperature":0.2}'
```

sre-anna: also ask them to run the debug collector so we get trace + worker logs. example command (they can run locally):

```
redwood debug collect --request-id r-110f8c2a --attach-logs --scrub-pii
# produces debug_bundle_1864127890.tar.gz (should be PII-scrubbed if they used --scrub-pii)
```

alex: quick triage note — we saw a small cluster of OOMs in the runtime around that time on pool g4d-2. i'll correlate traces once bundle is uploaded. if customer is on Dedicated the pool could differ.

maria: redaction guidance to give the customer: replace real names/emails/SSNs with tokens like <NAME_1>, <EMAIL_1>, <SSN_1>. Do NOT paste raw PII into the thread. If they can't scrub, have them provide the bundle with --scrub-pii flag and confirm which fields were masked.

jordan: for a quick local scrub they can run:

```
sed -E 's/[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}/<SSN_1>/g' prompt.txt > prompt_sanitized.txt
```

support-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-4521. Linked to internal incident IN-20260316-2 and assignee set to support-team.

sre-anna: once we have the bundle i'll run: `redwood debug analyze debug_bundle_1864127890.tar.gz --replay` to get stack traces and replay context. If it's an OOM pattern i'll propose a warmfix for the runtime and coordinate a patch.

maria: tagging @eng-bot for runtime visibility on the potential OOM pattern and model config.

eng-bot: pinged eng-runtime channel. ETA for initial look: ~2 hours.

alex: ask the customer to include the request origin (IP), region, and whether they used Hosted API or Dedicated capacity. That info speeds pool mapping.

jordan: sent the repro + scrub steps to the customer (included the curl + debug collect). I'll post back the bundle and curl output when they reply. :thumbsup:
